apicultura.name: Beekeeping
apicultura.short_description: Complete management and traceability system for beekeeping businesses - from hive to jar
apicultura.long_description: An end-to-end IT solution for the beekeeping industry covering the entire production chain: field data collection, complete lot traceability, quality control, standards compliance, and e-commerce integration. Whether you have a small apiary or a large operation with thousands of hives, our system adapts to your needs.

field_data.title: Field Data Acquisition
field_data.description: Offline-first mobile app for recording inspections, treatments, feedings, and incidents. Support for IoT sensors (scales, temperature, humidity).

traceability.title: Complete Traceability
traceability.description: Tracking from hive to jar: harvest lot → extraction → maturation → packaging. QR labeling for public verification.

quality.title: Quality Control & Compliance
quality.description: QC plan with analyses (moisture, HMF, diastase), treatment registry, automatic blocks for non-compliance.

planning.title: Production Planning
planning.description: Operational calendar based on IoT data and weather, resource allocation, cost tracking per operation.

inventory.title: Inventory Management
inventory.description: Real-time stock for consumables and finished products, automatic FIFO/FEFO, expiration alerts.

sales.title: B2C & B2B Sales
sales.description: E-commerce integration (Shopify/WooCommerce), complete order flow, CRM for recurring customers.

benefits: Complete traceability for every jar sold

food_traceability.name: Food Traceability
food_traceability.short_description: Event-sourcing system for complete food supply chain traceability - from farm to consumer
food_traceability.long_description: A robust food traceability platform based on event-sourcing, enabling forward and backward tracking of lots throughout the entire supply chain. Supports HACCP compliance, recall management, and audits. Suitable for producers, processors, logistics, and retail.

event_sourcing.title: Event-Sourcing Architecture
event_sourcing.description: Every operation is recorded as an immutable event: reception, transformation, split/merge, packaging, shipping. Complete and auditable history.

bidirectional_trace.title: Bidirectional Traceability
bidirectional_trace.description: Backward trace: 'Where does lot X come from?'. Forward trace: 'Where did lot X go?'. Impact analysis in seconds.

multi_actor.title: Multi-Actor Support
multi_actor.description: Producers, processors, logistics, retail - all on the same platform, with distinct roles and permissions.

compliance.title: Compliance & Audit
compliance.description: Complete 'who did what, when' journal, attached documents, HACCP/ISO report export.

recall.title: Recall Management
recall.description: Incident definition, automatic affected party list generation, real-time communications and confirmation tracking.

integration.title: ERP/WMS Integrations
integration.description: REST/GraphQL API, Webhooks, EDI import. Compatible with existing systems.

benefits: Increased trust from partners and consumers
